title: corydalis harry-smithii
intro: Corydalis harry-smithii, commonly known as Harry Smith's Corydalis, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its sedative and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis harry-smithii include acting as a sedative, antispasmodic, and analgesic, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including protopine alkaloids, berberine, and palmatine. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
